method: Read-only source review of startup, editor invalidation/completion, detached compiler bridge and actual failed input-test boundaries; no profiling or native rerun.

observations.finding: App initialization contains DocumentGroup composition and optional diagnostic event only; no compiler/network dispatch in the reviewed app init.

Startup observer writes asynchronously on its utility queue, bounds events/bytes/lifetime and uses one asynchronous main-queue probe; it does not issue readiness/AX queries. No synchronous main-thread wait found in its production call path.

Empty document live-preview path bypasses compilation and does not instantiate WKWebView. Catalogue bridge work runs detached; its later metadata serialization on the main actor was observed in source but has no measured latency attribution.

The single-character-paste case constructs an isolated CodeView in a UIKit window and calls native paste. It does not instantiate WorkspaceView or use the Cherri compiler; workspace catalogue/completion costs cannot directly explain this test's observed delay.

The retained GeneratedCloser failure occurred at the shared startup AX-query boundary before its keyboard/delimiter sequence; changing delimiter semantics would not target that observed failure boundary.
Editor completion publication already checks task cancellation and exact source/caret identity. The inspected code does not establish the cause of either missing native XCT issue.

nextRequiredEvidence: Actual final-source full57 native run and authenticated encrypted xcresult summary, retaining unchanged original limits and failures.
